_comment: 像素插画提示词清单：只写 SUBJECT（主体描述），风格块在 tools/make_art_prompt.py 里统一拼。改风格只改那一处，主体描述保持稳定，便于逐批重出。
_style: 16-bit pixel art, classic JRPG, vivid saturated colors, clean flat color areas, 3-tone shading, 1px dark outline, no dithering, bright palette

bg._comment: 场景背景。全幅横向场景，不要角色、不要文字，中心留安静区（UI 要压在上面）。
bg.menu_town: a peaceful fantasy town at golden hour seen from a low hill, timber-framed houses with tiled roofs, a stone town gate, hanging lanterns and cloth banners, a cobblestone main street, distant blue mountains, warm sunset sky with soft clouds
bg.guild_hall: the interior of an adventurers' guild hall, a large wooden notice board covered in pinned quest papers on the left, long tables and benches in the middle, a stone fireplace with a hanging cooking pot, cloth banners and mounted monster trophies on the walls, broad plank floor
bg.armory: an armoury workshop interior, racks of swords spears and shields along the wall, wooden mannequins wearing plate armour, a blacksmith's forge with glowing coals and an anvil, a workbench strewn with tools and whetstones
bg.shop: a cosy merchant shop interior, wooden shelves crowded with colourful potion bottles, boxes and rolled scrolls, a wooden counter with a brass balance scale and a ledger book, hanging oil lanterns, sacks of goods leaning against the wall
bg.storage: a warehouse storeroom interior, wooden crates and barrels stacked along both walls, high shelves with labelled boxes and iron-bound chests, a small barred window, dust motes floating in a shaft of light, plank floor
bg.library: a quiet scholar's library interior, tall bookshelves filled with tomes and scrolls, a reading desk with an open book and a candle, pigeonholes full of rolled parchments, a wooden ladder, warm lamplight, a potted plant in the corner
bg.dungeon_gate: the entrance hall of an ancient stone dungeon, a broad carved stairway descending into darkness, cracked flagstones, mossy damp walls, glowing blue rune torches, a heavy iron portcullis behind, pale shafts of daylight from an opening above
bg.dungeon_battle: a wide underground stone chamber used as a battleground, cracked flagstone floor with rubble, rows of thick stone pillars, wall torches burning with orange flame, ancient carved reliefs on the walls, drifting dust and haze, a distant glowing brazier
